annotations.text: Login — mirrors the current LoginComponent: navy→teal hero, anchor brand mark, outlined Material fields, coral pill CTA. No redesign, just phone widths and safe-area padding.

Telecaller home — the desktop sidebar becomes a bottom tab bar (5 primary destinations derived from roleNavItems() + workspaceNavItems(), rest under More). Dashboard hero and stat cards stack to one column.

Leads list — <app-table> switches to stacked-card mode below the md breakpoint: one card per row, same status pills and row actions, phone number becomes a tel: link. This one change carries most list screens.
